Passive.description: Default time allocation defining the passive validity of assigned internal network IP addresses.

Active.description: Network packet capture stream activated remotely under judicial authorization for target traffic analysis.

Dynamic.description: Real-time bit-rate consumption tracking data throughput across the wide area network uplink.

Location.description: Estimated geographic location attributes tied to the active ISP public WAN address lease.

Equipment.description: Static manufacturer metadata encoding MAC OUI identifiers and internal router system-on-chip models.

Status.description: The active policy state-machine flag of the boundary firewall ruleset (Low, Medium, High).

User.description: Dynamic internal device registry tracking MAC, hostnames, and local IP allocations of connected suspect devices.

Operational.description: Available volatile RAM metrics, monitored to prevent buffer exhaustion vulnerabilities during logging.

Service.description: Active Universal Plug and Play registry mappings tracking external port mapping requests made by internal nodes.

RFID.description: RFID token authentication transaction logs handled via proximity interaction passing through the gateway.

Historical.description: Historical audit database logs recording domain name resolution lookups generated by internal smart home nodes.

Spectrum.description: Configured Wi-Fi beacon transmission parameters and targeted 2.4GHz/5GHz channel allocations.

Environmental.description: On-board temperature tracking of the gateway mainboard processor under high logging loads.
